mission: Turn the certified BMR-001 foundation into Atlas's complete production agentic product: a production-scale, commercially operable, multi-provider, enterprise-governed developer platform in which versioned Agents pursue durable Missions and Atlas safely governs, executes, delivers, observes, bills, and proves business outcomes.

phases.title: Certified baseline and execution activation
phases.outcome: Verify BMR-001 closure and current repository truth, reconcile drift, install BMR-002 authority, and open an isolated execution lane.

phases.title: Shared product authority and agentic foundations
phases.outcome: Establish common Agent, Mission, Proposal, Decision, Action, Receipt, Outcome and Learning contracts and prove the first persistent local Mission.

phases.title: Durable agent runtime and business execution
phases.outcome: Build resumable governed autonomy, triggers, waits, budgets, approvals, handoff, memory provenance, exactly-once effects, cancellation and recovery.

phases.title: Developer platform and runtime interoperability
phases.outcome: Build coherent project, CLI, SDK and API journeys for Atlas-native and external reasoning runtimes while preserving Atlas authority.

phases.title: Production Atlas Cloud product
phases.outcome: Build durable production authorities, topology, capacity, SLOs, scaling, degradation, recovery, migration, deployment and operational ownership.

phases.title: Provider and channel product
phases.outcome: Build progressive provider readiness, harden Resend, certify an additional provider lane, and operate provider failures and drift truthfully.

phases.title: Enterprise governance and commercial Cloud product
phases.outcome: Build organisation governance, identity, audit, data lifecycle, usage/cost truth, quotas, billing settlement, lifecycle and support controls.

phases.title: Ecosystem, whole-product integration, deployment and closure
phases.outcome: Build extension readiness, integrate every first-class product plane, deploy the exact candidate to staging, certify the whole product, promote only when authorised, and close from evidence.

work_items.title: Verify BMR-001 closure and live Git state
work_items.outcome: Create a repository-derived closure verification record or a versioned post-closure erratum without mutating BMR-001 history.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve commit 4bf5da957d and tag atlas-bmr-001-closed
Record exact branch, HEAD, tree, dirty state, worktrees and post-closure drift
Verify 50/50 claim against canonical board
Verify evidence checksums and release decision
Record discrepancies only in BMR-002 errata
work_items.rollback: No product mutation; revert only BMR-002 verification artifacts
work_items.falsifier: Any closure claim is accepted from handover text without repository proof

work_items.title: Inventory the certified Atlas product and maturity
work_items.outcome: Map public packages, private cloud, Mirai interfaces, runtime adapters, channels, providers, deployment, tests, and evidence to truthful maturity states.
acceptance_criteria: Every BMR-001 capability is mapped to source and evidence
Implemented/local/staging/provider/production proof are distinguished
Public/private/Mirai boundaries are explicit
Fixtures and memory authorities are identified
work_items.rollback: Revert generated BMR-002 inventory only
work_items.falsifier: A source path or passing unit test is treated as production proof

work_items.title: Reconcile residual risks, drift, and adjacent programme ownership
work_items.outcome: Create a current gap and dependency map without absorbing Mirai ONE, AI Front Desk, AtlasAPI, Runtime-003, performance, provenance, or GTM authorities.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate writable authorities are identified
Each adjacent programme is dependency, provider, consumer, superseded, or out of scope
Post-certification drift is tested
Residual technical, operational, commercial and ecosystem debt is recorded
work_items.rollback: Revert BMR-002-only authority changes
work_items.falsifier: BMR-002 silently becomes every Atlas/Mirai roadmap

work_items.title: Reconcile BMR-002 execution thesis with repository evidence
work_items.outcome: Confirm or narrowly amend the Production Agentic Business Messaging Platform thesis using verified BMR-001 reality while preserving every first-class product plane and boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Agent/Mission, durable execution, developer, Cloud, provider, enterprise, commercial, ecosystem and operator-control planes are explicitly first-class
No plane is demoted to optional supporting infrastructure
Shared ownership and interface boundaries prevent duplicate authorities
Build-stream and final whole-product test order are recorded
Unresolvable founder choices are isolated as explicit decision records
No broad implementation begins before the decision record is sealed
work_items.required_environment: Planning branch or isolated continuation branch
work_items.rollback: Return affected items to BLOCKED_INTERNAL; do not edit BMR-001
work_items.falsifier: The selected programme can be satisfied by either a standalone Agent runtime or a standalone Cloud/provider/billing platform

work_items.title: Install and seal the execution authority
work_items.outcome: Install the BMR-002 package canonically, create the execution branch strategy, validate machine authorities, and establish persistent programme memory.
acceptance_criteria: No BMR-001 evidence or tag changes
JSON, dependencies, cross-references, checksums and secret scan pass
Execution log records exact active worktree and next action
Branch/worktree strategy preserves concurrent work
work_items.rollback: Revert the BMR-002-only installation commit
work_items.falsifier: Execution starts from an unvalidated or history-rewriting installation

work_items.title: Define AgentPackage and deployed Agent identity
work_items.outcome: Make a versioned Agent package and immutable deployed Agent version first-class public contracts.
acceptance_criteria: AgentPackage declares instructions, knowledge bindings, tools, policies, triggers, budgets, channel capabilities and compatibility
Deployment produces immutable agent_version_id tied to source digest
Public contract contains no private Cloud implementation
Schema evolution policy is documented
work_items.rollback: Version-gate new contract and preserve previous project compatibility
work_items.falsifier: An Agent remains only an unversioned prompt blob

work_items.title: Define durable Mission and lifecycle event contracts
work_items.outcome: Represent a bounded business goal as durable tenant-scoped state with an append-only lifecycle and explicit terminal outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Mission includes goal, subject/customer, conversation, agent version, constraints, budget, deadline, state and correlation
Lifecycle defines created/activated/waiting/approval/handoff/completed/failed/cancelled/expired
Events carry causation, correlation, actor and timestamps
Tenant and environment identity are server-derived
work_items.rollback: Keep additive schema; disable mission creation behind capability flag
work_items.falsifier: A Mission is interchangeable with one request/response or conversation row

work_items.title: Define Proposal, Decision, Action, Receipt, Outcome and Learning contracts
work_items.outcome: Separate reasoning proposals from Atlas-governed decisions, committed effects, delivery receipts, business outcomes, and reviewed learning.
acceptance_criteria: External runtimes can create proposals but not approvals or committed actions
Decision records policy version, reasons and required control
Action has idempotency scope and typed effect
Receipts distinguish commit, provider delivery, usage, cost, audit and outcome
LearningProposal cannot mutate durable memory before review
work_items.rollback: Version new envelopes; retain adapter for BMR-001 proposal format
work_items.falsifier: Model output is persisted directly as a completed business outcome

work_items.title: Install durable Mission persistence and migrations
work_items.outcome: Persist missions, lifecycle events, steps, waits, decisions, actions and receipt links in tenant-scoped durable storage.
acceptance_criteria: Restart preserves exact mission state
Unique/idempotency constraints reject conflicting replay
Tenant scope is enforced in every read/write path
Migrations are forward/backward compatible for the release window
work_items.rollback: Rollback application reads before destructive migration; use expand/contract
work_items.falsifier: Mission continuity depends on process memory

work_items.title: Implement deterministic local Mission coordinator
work_items.outcome: Run one complete observe–reason–propose–govern–act–observe Mission locally with deterministic fixtures and no credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Coordinator resumes from persisted event/state
At least one tool proposal crosses policy and approval boundary
Committed effect and all receipt types are inspectable
No Atlas account, provider credential, cloud, or paid model key is required
work_items.rollback: Disable mission coordinator and retain BMR-001 local path
work_items.falsifier: Demo is scripted output or a stateless mock without persistence

work_items.title: Expose Mission inspect, replay, pause, resume and cancel surfaces
work_items.outcome: Give developers safe control and observability over local Missions without database access.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect shows lifecycle, current wait, decisions, actions, receipts, usage and cost
Replay never re-commits completed actions
Pause/resume/cancel are durable commands
Commands return typed errors and correlation IDs
work_items.rollback: Hide new commands behind versioned feature capability
work_items.falsifier: Control commands directly mutate rows without runtime validation

work_items.title: Validate shared agentic product foundations
work_items.outcome: Obtain an adversarial build-readiness review proving that the shared Agent/Mission and authority contracts are genuine, durable and safe to integrate with every other product plane.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer reproduces the local Mission journey
Reviewer attempts authority bypass and restart loss
Public/private/Mirai interfaces are checked for duplicate authority
Review maps every foundation invariant to source/test/evidence
The verdict is explicitly build readiness, not Atlas release certification
Critical findings are repaired or G1 fails
work_items.rollback: Reopen failing P1 item; do not waive the gate
work_items.falsifier: The same implementing context self-certifies the complete Atlas product from a local runtime demonstration

work_items.title: Implement coordinator leasing, heartbeats and crash-safe resume
work_items.outcome: Allow many coordinators to process Missions without concurrent ownership or abandoned work.
acceptance_criteria: Lease acquisition is atomic and tenant-safe
Expired leases are recoverable
Long steps heartbeat without indefinite lock
Crash at every lifecycle boundary resumes from canonical state
work_items.rollback: Disable distributed coordinator; drain to single worker
work_items.falsifier: Two workers can commit the same mission step

work_items.title: Implement triggers, durable waits and scheduler
work_items.outcome: Start and resume Missions from inbound events, schedules, provider callbacks, approvals, deadlines and business signals.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers are idempotent and tenant-scoped
Durable waits survive restart and support timeout
Late/duplicate events are reconciled deterministically
Schedules respect environment and cancellation
work_items.rollback: Disable trigger type and preserve queued events for replay
work_items.falsifier: A callback can advance the wrong tenant or cancelled Mission

work_items.title: Install action-specific autonomy, risk and budget policy
work_items.outcome: Enforce server-side autonomy levels, risk classes, time/step/token/spend budgets and escalation behavior per action.
acceptance_criteria: Autonomy ladder L0–L4 is action-specific; L5 unrestricted is forbidden
Budget reservation/commit/release is atomic
Policy version and explanation are recorded
Exhausted/uncertain cases wait, hand off, or fail truthfully
work_items.rollback: Reduce maximum autonomy through server policy; no package migration required
work_items.falsifier: Agent instructions can raise their own autonomy or spend limit

work_items.title: Make approval, handoff, takeover and return durable
work_items.outcome: Model human control as first-class commands and state transitions usable by Mirai or another operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: Approval cannot be issued by the proposing runtime
Scope, expiry, actor, rationale and policy are recorded
Human takeover prevents agent side effects
Return-to-agent resumes from explicit state and context
Mirai consumes public contracts rather than private Atlas concepts
work_items.rollback: Force all affected actions to approval-required mode
work_items.falsifier: A model/tool adapter can self-approve or continue after takeover

work_items.title: Implement provenance-governed memory and reviewed learning
work_items.outcome: Allow Missions to read scoped knowledge and memory while keeping source provenance, confidence, retention, tenant boundary and review state explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Every retrieved item carries source/version/scope
Ephemeral observations are separate from durable memory
Learning proposals require configured review before promotion
Deletion/retention invalidates dependent memory
Untrusted provider/model content cannot silently become policy
work_items.rollback: Disable durable promotion and operate read-only knowledge
work_items.falsifier: The agent writes raw model conclusions directly to shared durable memory

work_items.title: Implement transactional action commit, outbox and effect workers
work_items.outcome: Commit business actions exactly once and deliver provider/tool effects through a durable outbox with canonical receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Action and outbox record commit atomically
Idempotency mismatch is rejected
Worker retries cannot duplicate committed business effects
Provider/tool response is reconciled to canonical receipt
External runtimes never receive raw provider credentials
work_items.rollback: Drain/disable new worker version and replay retained outbox safely
work_items.falsifier: Success is returned before durable commit or duplicate provider sends are possible

work_items.title: Implement cancellation, compensation, dead-letter and replay policy
work_items.outcome: Resolve partial failure without fabricating rollback or outcome success.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation distinguishes not-started, committed, in-flight and irreversible effects
Compensation is explicit business action, not database deletion
Dead letters carry reason, owner and safe replay command
Replay verifies current policy and idempotency
work_items.rollback: Quarantine affected action types; retain evidence and manual resolution path
work_items.falsifier: System claims an irreversible provider/business effect was rolled back

work_items.title: Certify a bounded proactive multi-step Mission
work_items.outcome: Prove an agent can initiate and continue a bounded business objective over time while respecting triggers, budgets, approvals, memory, recovery and outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Mission spans at least two wake-ups and three governed steps
Restart and duplicate events are injected
One action requires approval or handoff
Budget and deadline are enforced
Outcome receipt is based on committed evidence
Independent verifier reproduces the journey
work_items.rollback: Disable proactive trigger classes and preserve on-demand operation
work_items.falsifier: Proactivity is a cron script sending a prompt without durable Mission state

work_items.title: Evolve Atlas project schema and scaffold for Agents and Missions
work_items.outcome: Make agent packages, mission types, policies, tools, knowledge, tests and deployment intent understandable from one project.
acceptance_criteria: New project creates a runnable persistent Mission example
Existing BMR-001 project migrates without private knowledge
Project validation identifies unsupported capabilities
Local simulator remains zero-credential
work_items.rollback: Keep previous schema version readable and provide reverse guidance
work_items.falsifier: Only internal monorepo templates can create a valid agent

work_items.title: Ship coherent Mission CLI, SDK and API
work_items.outcome: Expose create, signal, inspect, pause, resume, cancel, approve, handoff, replay, deploy and evidence operations consistently.
acceptance_criteria: CLI/SDK/API share schemas and error model
Every mutating call supports idempotency and correlation
Capability/readiness inspection is machine-readable
Generated clients match current OpenAPI
work_items.rollback: Version endpoints/commands and retain prior compatibility adapter
work_items.falsifier: Different surfaces implement conflicting lifecycle semantics

work_items.title: Certify Atlas-native reasoning adapter
work_items.outcome: Connect Atlas-native inference to the proposal protocol with traceable context, tool proposals, budgets and typed failures.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter cannot commit actions or approve itself
Context is scoped and provenance-tagged
Model usage/cost is recorded without becoming billing settlement
Timeout/refusal/malformed output produce explicit states
work_items.rollback: Route to deterministic local adapter or approval/handoff
work_items.falsifier: Native adapter has privileged side-effect paths unavailable to external adapters

work_items.title: Certify external runtime proposal adapter
work_items.outcome: Allow an external agent runtime to reason and propose through Atlas without receiving authority over tenant, approval, credentials, effects or receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant/environment are server-derived
Proposal replay and signature/authentication are tested
External runtime cannot select provider credentials or fabricate receipt
At least one real external-runtime harness passes
work_items.rollback: Disable external runtime connection and retain Atlas-native path
work_items.falsifier: External runtime can call provider or durable business state directly

work_items.title: Install coding-agent documentation and Claude Code execution skill
work_items.outcome: Make Atlas and this programme executable by coding agents from public contracts and repository-resident instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Skill states authority hierarchy, active item workflow and safety rules
Examples are version-matched and executable
No secret/private operator knowledge is required
Worker delegation events can be logged without claiming unverified model identity
work_items.rollback: Revert skill/doc version; runtime remains compatible
work_items.falsifier: Coding agent succeeds only because prior chat context contains missing instructions

work_items.title: Run independent developer adoption and interoperability certification
work_items.outcome: Prove two independent journeys: empty-folder Atlas-native and existing external agent integration.
acceptance_criteria: Independent agent/developer completes both journeys
No direct database/provider access is used
Governed action, recovery and receipts are observed
Friction/time/failures are captured and critical defects fixed
work_items.required_environment: Two fresh checkouts with no maintainer shell history
work_items.rollback: Hold release and return failing surface to owner
work_items.falsifier: Only founding-team monorepo execution is demonstrated

work_items.title: Consolidate production authority and fail-closed configuration
work_items.outcome: Ensure production identity, mission, policy, approval, action, outbox, receipt, usage and credential authorities have one durable owner.
acceptance_criteria: Memory/test/fixture authorities are rejected in staging/production
One writable owner exists per authority
Startup emits typed failure for unsafe fallback
Local simulator behavior is unchanged
work_items.rollback: Roll back service/config version; never enable ambiguous fallback silently
work_items.falsifier: Production can start with memory-backed mission/action/usage authority

work_items.title: Define workload, capacity, cost and failure models
work_items.outcome: Model representative tenants, conversations, Missions, steps, inference, tools, provider events, media, receipts and operational cost.
acceptance_criteria: Steady, peak, burst and abuse profiles are versioned
Tenant distribution and provider quotas are included
Per-mission and per-action cost drivers are measurable
Assumptions and confidence bounds are explicit
work_items.rollback: Version model; no production mutation
work_items.falsifier: Capacity target is an unsupported round number without workload trace

work_items.title: Implement database, queue and worker partitioning
work_items.outcome: Bound failure domains and noisy-neighbour effects across mission coordination, actions, providers and tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Partition keys preserve ordering where required
Poison work is quarantined
Fairness and per-tenant admission are observable
Pool/lock/lag saturation has defined behavior
work_items.rollback: Restore prior routing config after draining workers
work_items.falsifier: One tenant/provider can monopolise workers or exhaust shared pools

work_items.title: Install causal observability, SLOs and error-budget policy
work_items.outcome: Trace each Mission from trigger through reasoning, decision, action, provider/tool delivery, receipt and outcome with user-relevant SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Trace context crosses service/queue/provider boundaries where possible
Telemetry is redacted and not business authority
SLIs measure mission/action/delivery correctness and freshness
Error-budget consequences name release/incident actions
work_items.rollback: Roll back instrumentation/rules independently; preserve receipt authority
work_items.falsifier: Dashboard existence is treated as SLO proof or secrets/PII appear in telemetry

work_items.title: Implement autoscaling, backpressure and graceful degradation
work_items.outcome: Scale on meaningful backlog/saturation while preserving bounded admission and truthful degraded states.
acceptance_criteria: Burst recovers within measured objective
Scale-down drains leases/outbox safely
Overload rejects or defers explicitly
Inference/provider faults never fabricate completion
Local/critical control paths remain available where designed
work_items.rollback: Restore fixed capacity and conservative admission profile
work_items.falsifier: Autoscaling amplifies retries or the system accepts work it cannot durably process

work_items.title: Prove backup, restore and disaster recovery
work_items.outcome: Recover durable authorities with measured RPO/RTO and reconcile missions, outbox, receipts, usage and provider state.
acceptance_criteria: Independent restore succeeds from documented artifacts
RPO/RTO are measured, not aspirational
Post-restore reconciliation identifies lost/duplicate/unknown states
Credentials are not copied unsafely
Runbook names decision authority
work_items.rollback: Discard restored target; retain source backups and evidence
work_items.falsifier: Backup existence is claimed without restoring and reconciling

work_items.title: Prove deployment, migration, canary and rollback safety
work_items.outcome: Create reproducible source-to-artifact promotion with expand/contract migrations and tested rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact digest maps to reviewed commit and dependencies
Migrations pass compatibility window tests
Canary exercises real Mission lifecycle
Rollback is timed and preserves durable events/outbox
No secret is embedded in artifact
work_items.rollback: Execute documented application/config rollback; avoid destructive schema rollback
work_items.falsifier: Rollback requires history rewrite or loses committed actions

work_items.title: Deploy the Atlas Cloud product plane to a production-shaped staging preview
work_items.outcome: Operate the durable Atlas Cloud product plane in a production-shaped staging preview for Cloud reliability and integration-readiness testing; do not treat it as the final product release candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Durable database, queue, workers, secrets and observability are deployed from reproducible artifacts
Agent/Mission runtime contracts operate on the Cloud topology
Load, fault, recovery, migration and rollback tests required by P4 pass
The preview exposes documented interfaces for provider, enterprise and commercial integration
Evidence explicitly states that P4 is a Cloud product-plane preview, not G8 whole-product staging certification
work_items.rollback: Rollback release and drain work using runbook
work_items.falsifier: A Cloud-only staging preview is presented as the complete Atlas staging release

work_items.title: Validate Production Atlas Cloud build readiness
work_items.outcome: Publish a falsifiable capacity, reliability, recovery and operational-ownership verdict for the Cloud product plane before whole-product integration.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer reproduces critical load, fault and recovery tests
Capacity envelope names limits and exclusions
Every alert has owner, escalation and runbook
Cloud interfaces are compatible with the Agent, provider, enterprise and commercial planes
The verdict is Cloud build readiness, not final Atlas release certification
Critical findings block integration
work_items.required_environment: Production-shaped Cloud test environment or staging preview + fresh verifier context
work_items.rollback: Return affected item to IN_PROGRESS; no waiver by implementer
work_items.falsifier: Cloud readiness is inferred from configuration, unit tests, or a partial runtime and promoted as complete Atlas readiness

work_items.title: Build provider readiness registry and certification harness
work_items.outcome: Evaluate provider/account/environment readiness progressively instead of using one universal supported flag.
acceptance_criteria: States use DECLARED through PRODUCTION_PROVEN vocabulary
Readiness is scoped by provider account, capability, environment, region and version
Harness covers auth, eligibility, webhooks, retry, rate, spend, media, templates and reconciliation
Blocked/deprecated states are visible
work_items.required_environment: Local + CI + provider sandboxes where available
work_items.rollback: Demote readiness state and disable affected capability
work_items.falsifier: A local adapter test promotes all accounts/regions to production-supported

work_items.title: Harden Resend email operations
work_items.outcome: Convert BMR-001 real-send proof into repeatable email operation with inbound/outbound events, authenticity, reconciliation, quotas and outage behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Domain/account eligibility is recorded
Webhook verification and replay/deduplication pass
Provider status maps truthfully to Atlas receipts
Rate/quota/spend controls are observable
Outage and credential rotation runbooks pass
work_items.rollback: Disable account/capability and route to handoff; preserve queued state
work_items.falsifier: One historical email proves ongoing production readiness

work_items.title: Score and select the second provider lane
work_items.outcome: Choose one provider from repository demand and current eligibility evidence using value, geography, complexity, cost and support burden.
acceptance_criteria: At least three candidates are scored
Selection is not based on declared channel count alone
Account eligibility and budget are explicit
Unselected providers remain truthful DECLARED/BLOCKED states
Default recommendation is Twilio SMS only if current evidence still supports it
work_items.rollback: Select another candidate through versioned decision; no core redesign
work_items.falsifier: Provider is selected because an adapter filename already exists

work_items.title: Reach provider sandbox proof for the selected lane
work_items.outcome: Onboard credentials/account, validate authenticity, send/receive or equivalent sandbox events, reconcile delivery and document limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Account/environment eligibility is captured
Credential lifecycle and webhook authenticity pass
Rate/retry/delivery mapping pass
Evidence includes provider IDs redacted safely
State reaches PROVIDER_SANDBOX_PROVEN only
work_items.rollback: Revoke credentials, disable lane and demote readiness
work_items.falsifier: Sandbox is unavailable but the lane is marked proven

work_items.title: Run a bounded provider-plane live Mission journey
work_items.outcome: Operate a real multi-step Mission over an authorised provider account to validate the provider product plane before complete-product integration.
acceptance_criteria: Exact provider account, capability, region and environment are recorded
Mission includes policy or approval, committed Action, durable outbox, provider effect and authentic callback/reconciliation
Delivery and business Outcome remain distinct
Usage, cost, audit and support signals are captured for downstream integration
Evidence explicitly states that this is provider-plane readiness, not G8 whole-product staging certification
work_items.rollback: Disable provider account/lane and hand off active Missions
work_items.falsifier: A single live send or provider-plane journey is presented as complete Atlas product proof

work_items.title: Exercise provider outage, drift and deprecation operations
work_items.outcome: Prove Atlas responds truthfully to provider downtime, webhook drift, API/version change, quota exhaustion and planned deprecation.
acceptance_criteria: Provider failure does not fabricate delivery/outcome
Backoff and retry obey provider/idempotency constraints
Version drift is detected before promotion
Deprecation has customer migration path
Support owner and communication template exist
work_items.rollback: Demote provider readiness and disable new admissions
work_items.falsifier: Provider outage triggers uncontrolled retry storm or false success

work_items.title: Validate provider and channel product readiness
work_items.outcome: Review exact account/environment evidence and issue truthful provider-product readiness states before whole-product integration, without extrapolation.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer verifies redacted account, environment and region scope
Mocks, sandbox and live proof are distinguished
Blocked limitations remain visible
Provider operations integrate with Mission, Cloud, usage/cost, support and audit authorities
The verdict is provider-plane readiness, not complete Atlas release certification
No universal supported claim is inferred
work_items.required_environment: Independent context + provider/staging access as authorised
work_items.rollback: Demote provider state and reopen failed item
work_items.falsifier: Implementer self-promotes a provider state without independent evidence

work_items.title: Implement organisation, project and environment governance
work_items.outcome: Make ownership, environment separation, lifecycle and server-derived tenant context explicit across Atlas Cloud.
acceptance_criteria: Organisation/project/environment hierarchy is canonical
Production/test boundaries are enforced
Deletion/suspension states are explicit
No client-selected tenant authority
work_items.rollback: Disable new lifecycle paths and retain existing records
work_items.falsifier: A request body can select another tenant/environment

work_items.title: Implement RBAC, machine identity and scoped credentials
work_items.outcome: Enforce least-privilege human and machine access for development, deployment, operations, approval and billing.
acceptance_criteria: Role/scope matrix is versioned
Machine credentials are environment-scoped and rotatable
Approval authority is separate from proposal authority
Privilege escalation and confused-deputy tests pass
work_items.rollback: Revoke new scopes/credentials and fall back to stricter access
work_items.falsifier: Broad administrator token is required by ordinary runtime operations

work_items.title: Install SSO assessment, audit export, encryption and secret controls
work_items.outcome: Provide enterprise-ready control evidence without making unsupported certification claims.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC/SSO scope is justified and tested if implemented
Audit export is tenant-scoped, tamper-evident and documented
Encryption/key/secret ownership and rotation are tested
CMK/SCIM are assessed but not built without justified demand
No SOC2/ISO/GDPR/HIPAA/PCI claim exceeds evidence
work_items.rollback: Disable federation integration and retain local secure admin path
work_items.falsifier: Marketing compliance claim is created from a control checklist alone

work_items.title: Implement retention, deletion, legal-hold decision and incident controls
work_items.outcome: Make data lifecycle and security/abuse response executable across messages, knowledge, memory, missions, receipts and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Data inventory and retention classes exist
Deletion/export is tenant-scoped and reconciles derived memory/indexes
Legal hold is an explicit supported/unsupported decision
Incident severity, notification, containment and evidence roles are named
Provider data handling is recorded
work_items.rollback: Pause deletion jobs, preserve request ledger, and use manual controlled runbook
work_items.falsifier: Deleting a primary row leaves retrievable derived memory or provider-state ambiguity

work_items.title: Build canonical usage, cost and attribution ledger
work_items.outcome: Record model, runtime, tool, provider, media, storage and observability usage against tenant/project/environment/agent/mission/action.
acceptance_criteria: Usage events are idempotent and attributable
Estimated versus settled cost is distinguished
Provider/model invoices can reconcile to internal events
Atlas ledger remains source of runtime truth
No double counting across retries
work_items.rollback: Disable rating/settlement while retaining raw canonical usage events
work_items.falsifier: Stripe/provider aggregate is treated as the only canonical runtime usage record

work_items.title: Implement quotas, spending controls and abuse/fraud responses
work_items.outcome: Enforce understandable plan and customer controls before costly work is admitted.
acceptance_criteria: Hard/soft limits and alert thresholds are explicit
Spend is reserved before model/provider/tool work where feasible
Race-safe enforcement passes
Abuse response can suspend narrowly without corrupting state
Override is audited and expires
work_items.rollback: Switch to conservative admission/approval mode; revoke overrides
work_items.falsifier: Concurrent Missions can exceed hard spend cap materially

work_items.title: Implement bounded self-serve and billing test settlement
work_items.outcome: Operate signup, organisation/project creation, sandbox, deployment, channel connection, usage transparency and Stripe test billing lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Starter sandbox works before live provider access
Plans/quotas use provisional versioned metrics, not unsupported final prices
Stripe test meter/settlement reconciles to Atlas ledger
Failed payment, upgrade, downgrade, cancellation, export and deletion paths are tested
Enterprise handoff and support boundary are explicit
work_items.rollback: Disable new paid activation and retain free/local access; void test artifacts
work_items.falsifier: A successful checkout is treated as commercial readiness without usage reconciliation/support

work_items.title: Validate enterprise and commercial Cloud product readiness
work_items.outcome: Adversarially verify the enterprise-governance and commercial product plane before whole-product integration.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant-isolation and RBAC negative tests pass
Audit, retention, deletion, encryption and incident controls are exercised
Usage, cost, quota, spend and billing test settlement reconcile
Signup, organisation, project, environment and support lifecycle are outside-in tested
The verdict is product-plane readiness, not complete Atlas release certification
Unsupported compliance or pricing claims are absent
work_items.rollback: Reopen failed item and prevent beta activation
work_items.falsifier: Controls are certified only by their implementer or marketing copy

work_items.title: Stabilise extension contracts and certification kit
work_items.outcome: Let third parties build runtime, model, tool, channel/provider and solution extensions against bounded public contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Extension types and authority limits are explicit
Compatibility/support/deprecation policy exists
Conformance tests include security and failure behavior
Private Cloud implementation is not leaked
Marketplace is not required
work_items.rollback: Deprecate/disable extension capability by version and preserve core runtime
work_items.falsifier: An extension can bypass Atlas policy, credentials, tenant or receipt authority

work_items.title: Prove independent extension adoption
work_items.outcome: Have an independent context build one useful extension and solution pack using only the public kit and documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Extension passes conformance/security suite
Solution pack runs local zero-credential journey
No private imports or maintainer instructions are used
Friction and missing contracts are repaired
work_items.required_environment: Fresh checkout / independent developer or coding agent
work_items.rollback: Reject extension and fix kit; core runtime unaffected
work_items.falsifier: Founding-team code is relabelled as third-party adoption

work_items.title: Integrate and seal the complete Atlas product release candidate
work_items.outcome: Assemble exact versions of every first-class product plane into one source-to-artifact release candidate before whole-product certification.
acceptance_criteria: All required product-plane work items have defensible build-readiness evidence
One exact source commit, dependency lock, migration set, configuration set and artifact set are bound
Cross-plane contracts have no duplicate writable authority
Public/private/Mirai boundaries remain coherent
The candidate includes Agent, Cloud, provider, enterprise, commercial and ecosystem functionality
No staging or production claim is made before deployment and whole-product tests
work_items.required_environment: CI/build environment plus immutable candidate artifact store
work_items.rollback: Archive the failed candidate, reopen the owning product-plane item, and keep the last known candidate unchanged
work_items.falsifier: A partial Agent demo or isolated Cloud/provider stack is labelled the complete Atlas product candidate

work_items.title: Deploy the exact complete-product candidate to staging
work_items.outcome: Deploy the sealed integrated candidate, migrations, configuration and secret references to staging without rebuilding or mutating the artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Staging runs the exact reviewed artifact and configuration digests
Expand/contract migrations and worker compatibility checks pass
All required services become healthy with causal observability
No manual unrecorded data or credential mutation is used
Rollback and stop-admission paths are current before whole-product testing
work_items.rollback: Restore the previous staging release and archive the failed deployment with exact provenance
work_items.falsifier: Staging is tested from a locally rebuilt or post-review modified artifact

work_items.title: Run whole-product staging certification and independent adoption
work_items.outcome: Test the complete Atlas product after all planes are built, integrated and deployed, then issue an independent staging verdict for the exact candidate.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh user completes signup, organisation, project, environment, sandbox, Agent deployment and provider connection
A durable Mission crosses context, Proposal, policy, approval/handoff, Action, outbox, provider/tool effect, receipt and evidence-backed outcome
Atlas-native and one external runtime complete the governed path
Tenant isolation, RBAC, webhook authenticity, abuse, quota and spend negative tests pass
Usage/cost ledger, billing test settlement, audit export and data-lifecycle controls reconcile
Load, backpressure, provider outage, worker crash, backup/restore, migration and rollback tests pass
Independent developers complete greenfield, existing-agent and extension journeys without private knowledge
No unresolved critical defect or unsupported maturity claim remains
work_items.required_environment: Exact staging candidate + authorised provider sandbox/test account + billing test mode + fresh independent contexts
work_items.rollback: Hold promotion, roll back staging if unsafe, reopen the owning work item, repair, rebuild the complete candidate and rerun the full certification
work_items.falsifier: Disconnected component demos or pre-integration tests are substituted for one causally connected whole-product journey

work_items.title: Promote to bounded production and run the customer operations cohort
work_items.outcome: Promote the staging-certified candidate only under explicit authority, then operate sustained real customer Missions inside a declared provider, capacity, spend, data and support envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit user/founder production authority is recorded
Region, customer/tenant cap, provider accounts, data classes, spend, SLOs, support hours and rollback owner are recorded
Canary and live full-product Mission pass with reconciled receipts and cost
The cohort runs for a declared evidence window with handoff and incident ownership exercised
Failure triggers stop-admission, provider-lane disablement, handoff or rollback as designed
No global, 24x7, every-provider or general-availability claim is made
Push, merge, publication and tag actions remain separately authorised
work_items.required_environment: Explicitly authorised limited-production environment and customer/provider cohort
work_items.rollback: Stop admission, drain or hand off active Missions, disable affected provider lanes, roll back application/configuration and preserve evidence
work_items.falsifier: Claude promotes production or onboards unbounded customers without explicit authority and an operable support/rollback envelope

work_items.title: Final independent certification and BMR-002 closure
work_items.outcome: Issue a truthful terminal verdict, close or isolate residual risk, and preserve exact programme provenance.
acceptance_criteria: All dependency-reachable work items have defensible disposition
Independent review replays the complete staging evidence and critical product-plane evidence
Known limitations, deferred work and external blockers remain visible
BMR-001 history remains unchanged
If P7-006 is not PASS solely for missing production authority/cohort access, issue the staging-certified terminal verdict
ATLAS_BMR_002_EXECUTION_COMPLETE requires P7-006 PASS
Closure tag, merge, push and publication are only prepared unless separately authorised
work_items.rollback: Use ROLLED_BACK or FAILED verdict; preserve evidence and do not rewrite history
work_items.falsifier: Programme declares completion from workstream readiness or a staging pass while required production evidence is absent

blockers.description: Required before ATLAS-BMR2-P7-006 may promote limited production.
blockers.unblock_action: Record the bounded production promotion authority described in the deployment runbook.
